# LLM Readiness

> LLM Readiness audits how well AI assistants and agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, shopping agents) can find, read, understand and recommend a business website, and fixes what blocks them. Based in Germany, serving clients in English and German.

## Services and prices (net, plus VAT where applicable)

- Free Quick Check: instant technical score 0–100 across five categories, top three issues. https://llmreadiness.com/check
- Readiness Audit: from 1,900 €. Full audit of six categories including an AI visibility test with 10 real customer questions, written report, 60-minute walkthrough, prioritized roadmap. Delivered within 10 working days. https://llmreadiness.com/pricing
- Implementation: from 6,500 €. We implement the roadmap or guide the client's agency: structured data, llms.txt, content rewrite, crawler fixes, optional API or MCP endpoint. 4 to 8 weeks.
- Monitoring: 490 € per month. Monthly re-run of audit and AI visibility test with a fixed question set, competitor tracking, short report.
- Agency partner program: white-label audits and revenue share. https://llmreadiness.com/agencies

## How the audit works

Six categories with weights: Crawler access (20 %), Discoverability (15 %), Structured data (25 %), Content clarity (25 %), Agent interfaces (15 %), AI visibility (30 %). Grades: A 85+, B 70+, C 50+, D 30+, E below 30. Full methodology: https://llmreadiness.com/methodology

## Who it is for

Companies with 10 to 500 employees that sell or generate leads online: e-commerce, B2B manufacturers and dealers, hotels, software vendors, service businesses with bookings. Web agencies that want to add agent readiness to their offer.
